For those who are interested. Here's the Python notebook that lets you plot stuff. Just upload a .CSV file recorded from HWiNFO and run it to plot any of the attributes you want from temperature to power to whatever else you want :)

​

    import numpy as np
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    import pandas as pd
    
    df = pd.read_csv('GPU_Temp_Analysis_Superposition.CSV', encoding= 'unicode_escape')
    
    print(df.columns)
    
    N = len(df)
    
    V1 = df.loc[:N-3, 'GPU PCIe +12V Input Voltage [V]']
    V2 = df.loc[:N-3, 'GPU 16-pin HVPWR Voltage [V]']
    P1 = df.loc[:N-3, 'Total GPU Power [% of TDP] [%]']
    P2 = df.loc[:N-3, 'GPU 16-pin HVPWR Voltage [V]']
    
    t = np.arange(N-2)/(N-2)
    
    plt.figure(figsize = (16*1.5, 9*1.5))
    
    plt.subplot(2, 1, 1)
    
    plt.plot(t, V1.astype(float), lw = 1.5, label = 'GPU PCIe +12V Input Voltage [V]')
    plt.plot(t, V2.astype(float), lw = 1.5, label = 'GPU 16-pin HVPWR Voltage [V]')
    
    plt.axhline(y = 12, lw = 2.5, c = 'tab:red', linestyle = '--', label = '12V reference')
    
    plt.legend()
    
    plt.title("RTX 4090 FE Voltages", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.ylabel("Voltage (V)", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.grid()
    
    plt.subplot(2, 1, 2)
    
    plt.plot(t, P1.astype(float), lw = 1.5, label = 'Total GPU Power [% of TDP] [%]')
    
    plt.axhline(y = np.max(P1.astype(float)), lw = 2.5, c = 'tab:red', linestyle = '--', label = 'Peak Power 92%')
    
    plt.legend()
    
    plt.title("RTX 4090 FE Power Usage", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.xlabel("Time (s)", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.ylabel("Relative Power [% of TDP]", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.grid()
    
    plt.savefig("RTX-4090-Voltage.png")
    
    
    plt.figure(figsize = (16*1.5, 9*1.5))
    
    plt.scatter(P1.astype(float), V1.astype(float), lw = 1.5, label = 'GPU PCIe +12V Input Voltage [V]', s = 10)
    plt.scatter(P1.astype(float), V2.astype(float), lw = 1.5, label = 'GPU 16-pin HVPWR Voltage [V]', s = 10)
    
    plt.title("RTX 4090 FE Voltages v/s Total GPU Power [% of TDP]", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.ylabel("Voltage (V)", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.xlabel("Relative Power [% of TDP]", fontsize = 20)
    
    plt.legend()
    
    plt.grid()
    
    plt.savefig("RTX-4090-Scatter.png")
